MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- MappingPocPage
|   `-- MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
|       |-- injected DiagramService [G] + CanvasHistoryService [E]
|       `-- injected workspaceStorage or new WorkspaceStorage
|-- Page coordination and retained state
|   |-- project/catalog snapshot; activeId; mounted document IDs
|   |-- explorer tab; change preview; search focus and matches
|   |-- create/save/delete state; errors; workspace busy state
|   |-- pendingTransfer: source, mode, selected IDs, checkpoint ID
|   `-- transfers: workspace transaction records [E]
|-- CanvasWorkspace: owns draft/session lifetimes
|   |-- public read stores: drafts, changes, dirtyScenes
|   |-- controllers: document ID -> MappingDocumentController
|   |-- DraftMetadata
|   |   |-- name, savedName, savedScene, savedEdges, revisionId
|   |   `-- representationId, hidden, busy, viewport, focusBox
|   |-- setDrafts(seed) -> create CanvasSession
|   |-- replacement/removal -> unsubscribe + dispose old session
|   `-- session commits -> changed() + persistence notification
|-- CanvasSession: publishes controller-owned state
|   |-- creates controller with diagram/history services [D]
|   |-- document store -> immutable MappingGridDocument reference
|   |-- presentation store -> display + diagramViews
|   |-- selection store -> selection membership
|   |-- controls store -> focus, threads, action surfaces
|   |-- geometry store -> endpointBounds, cell, version
|   |-- status store -> isDirty, sceneDirty, canUndo, canRedo
|   |-- dirty computation needs current scene/edge keys + saved baseline + name
|   `-- retains baseline/subscription; dispose releases subscription/listeners
|-- MappingDocumentController: live editing authority [D]
|   |-- retains snapshot, runtime context, layout, node cache, listeners
|   |-- MappingGridDocument
|   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene [A]
|   |   |   |-- root: nested GridBox instances
|   |   |   `-- contents: local content ID -> immutable Diagram [B]
|   |   |-- edges: DiagramConnection[]
|   |   |-- sections: content ID -> section ranges
|   |   `-- optional canvas jumps
|   |-- MappingCanvasState
|   |   |-- selection: SelectionState
|   |   |   |-- owns membership and insertion order
|   |   |   `-- whole instance OR captured region with ASCII/revision/rect/IDs
|   |   |-- diagramViews: per-instance content folding
|   |   |-- display: DisplayState [C]
|   |   |   `-- rootIds + FloatingPane nodes linked by childIds
|   |   `-- controls: MappingControls
|   |       |-- activeBoxId, selectionFocusId, activeThreadId
|   |       `-- surfaces: actions, projection choice, prompts, ask/status
|   `-- version + canvasRevisionId + canUndo/canRedo
|-- CanvasDisplayNode: read-only registry over existing state
|   |-- canvasDisplayNodes(document, canvas, version, cell, endpointBounds)
|   |-- grid:<boxId>: diagram | group; cell bounds; content; children
|   |-- floating:<id>: pane; pixel geometry; placement; value
|   |-- floating:edge:<id>: arrow derived from document.edges
|   `-- returns cloned nodes; geometry has no second writable store
|-- SourcePaneViewState: owns live scroll and camera state
|   |-- per-document pane entries, cameras, capture cache, timers
|   |-- bind/connect gives viewer ownership; disconnect retains last scroll
|   |-- captureDisplay/captureCamera sample current view for persistence
|   `-- prune removes stale panes; replacement flushes and disposes timers
|-- Rendered page composition
|   |-- MappingSubmenu + workspace save/restore/export/import controls
|   |-- mounted draft -> SourcePane document/active contexts
|   |   `-- DraggableDiagramCanvas -> MappingPocSelectionCanvas
|   |       |-- consumes session; active state gates interaction
|   |       `-- callbacks: edit composer, transfer, undo, jump, busy state
|   |-- FloatingPane -> MappingDiagramExplorer
|   |-- DiagramSearchPanel + ChangeSessionPreview
|   `-- DiagramEditComposer + new-diagram dialog
|-- Search and agent integration
|   |-- DiagramSearchService: page creates worker-backed service; disposes it
|   |-- search input: settled catalog revisions + visible drafts + proposal
|   |-- reveal checks revision/hash before assigning focusBox
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand [D]
|   `-- DiagramEditCoordinator + DiagramRevisionReceiver
|-- Persistence and navigation boundaries [E]
|   |-- startup -> loadProjectRepresentations + storage.load
|   |-- open -> documentFromRevision/historyFromRevision -> draft seed
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence translates live owners into record changes
|   |-- save -> captured history/scene/edges -> saveMappingProjectDiagram
|   |   `-- acknowledgement updates the captured saved baseline
|   |-- workspace capture -> documents, histories, sampled view, transfers
|   `-- transfer publication -> storage.save -> installWorkspace
`-- Page cleanup responsibilities
    |-- dispose diagram edit coordinator, workspace, search, view state
    `-- locally created storage: flush when loaded, then dispose
